A place that sells peace
Mar 2024 • Solo
Today is 14AL, I stopped by the restaurant to have dinner. The outdoor corner has a cupboard that reminds me of the childhood memories of the previous generation and the rows of trees and evening lights are very pleasant. The dish that suits my taste especially is gourd soup with shrimp. Must have for me. Today is the 4th time I ordered this soup. Occasionally I will stop by here to buy some peace. You should also try it to feel it.

Best restaurants in Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City
Feb 2024 • Solo
I searched on Google Maps and visited!
The very elegant owner welcomed me with a bright smile and kept checking on me throughout the meal to make sure there were no inconveniences and how the food tasted.
Everything was so perfect that I wanted to visit again! The seafood fried rice was really delicious and the spring rolls were great too! This is the best restaurant I would recommend to friends traveling to Thao Dien in Ho Chi Minh City!
